explanation: This module translates Apache Commons CSV 1.10.0 core behavior faithfully into Python using only standard library modules. UTF-16 code-unit validations are enforced to ensure single code unit validation for delimiter, quote, and escape characters, rejecting supplementary characters that require surrogate pairs. Lexer whitespace and trim operations match Java's Character.isWhitespace and String.trim semantics precisely. Quoting and escape rules in both lexing and printing (including minimal quoting heuristics, non-numeric quoting, null handling vs empty string distinction, and exact line separators) replicate CSVFormat, CSVParser, and CSVPrinter.
